{{Quote|Only honorable beings repay their debts. The Imperials merely take and take&mdash;and then move on.|Unidentified Bartender to Han Solo|<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who worked in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NERC">According to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'' take place in [[0 ABY]].</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his group managed to obtain some information regarding the missing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] contact [[Mak Luunim]] from the bartender, who believed that Luunim's recent [[Death/Legends|death]] was not accidental and was the work of [[Nal Kenuun]], a Muun [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] whom Luunim owed [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to. When pressed for more information on Luunim, the bartender became uncharacteristically quiet and retreated to the cantina's backroom to wash the dishes.<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />
